record.question: How should reported compiler defects be repaired?

options.strongest_objection: Several independent paths require executable coverage

requirements.statement: Blocked parks request no release, wait paths remain unique, reducer ancestry compiles, output validation matches check, execution citations bind sha, pre-start failures preserve journal readability, and emitted await syntax parses
requirements.counterexample: A descendant park spawns, a long wait collides, a list dependency crashes emission, unchecked probe emits, a fabricated sha passes, or a pre-start event prevents resume

requirements.statement: Changed defaults require explicit resolution, added defaults are bound, inline unknown inputs refuse, named removals work, plans retain provenance and subprocess output uses UTF-8
requirements.counterexample: An ignored default change, unbound new input, unused typo without warning, unrecorded plan or Windows decoding crash

requirements.statement: Harness-only root graph edits and untracked workflow artifacts are clean while any source, existing evidence, prompt, trusted config or linked worktree dirt is retained and named in the row
requirements.counterexample: An ordinary STATUS edit makes all gates stale, or a content edit is hidden by a broad Markdown exemption

requirements.statement: Runtime transcript frames normalize exactly, mixed readings stay recordable, replay state is compiled and compact, irreversible ancestors cannot memo, legacy rejudge refuses, sentinel notes stay isolated, path aliases and Unicode hash consistently, and new once-only keys use SHA-256 with legacy replay migration
requirements.counterexample: Wrapped native prompts refuse, a memo supplied inline turns red green, the operator carries two full prompt copies, a sentinel follows a note, or a malformed surrogate crashes hashing

requirements.statement: Targeted prefix slots remain stable until a changed gate demands a fresh read, builders compare fresh tips with source final branch state, gates keep their exact judged tip, different lanes avoid serial warnings and effective SSH identities prevent alias races
requirements.counterexample: A declaration alone closes the prefix, a cached read authorizes a memo after a fork, a source-intermediate tip forces all builders live, or a remote alias bypasses lane exclusivity

checks.scope: Assemble and run actual compiled launches with immutable archives and focused mocked provenance boundaries
assumptions: Runtime prefix predictions remain conditional on the recorded workflow call ordering

checks.scope: Native git repositories and linked worktrees, real gate wrapper and exact Markdown diff policy

checks.scope: Native journal and transcript fixtures, source corroboration, compact replay state and canonical hash parity

checks.scope: Execute actual emitted graph programs under local Workflow stubs to exercise replay, lanes, rejudge and irreversible validation
assumptions: Local agent fixtures model the supported Workflow call ordering

challenges.claim: Could a failed attempt with no agent have a real result to replay?
challenges.resolution: Only empty-agent failed pre-start events are skipped; result or started events still refuse malformed identity.
